rationale: Replaced ten fixed, inert, aliased, dishonest, or misleading controls with one literal recoverable scene-profile axis.; Added four immutable exact-public profiles and twelve generalized profiles crossing horizontal/vertical orientation with N=2 through N=7.; Implemented exact relevant-color collection, all-colors-one-row orientation detection, first-cell axis sorting, and the two distinct N by N output forms.; Made the gray square exactly N by N and added a zero moat that can truncate or split lines, matching canonical occlusion rather than avoiding it.; Allowed occluded line colors to be noncontiguous while requiring horizontal colors to occupy one distinct row and vertical colors one distinct column.; Expanded canvas sizes, line spans, axis layouts, palettes, and gray positions across difficulty bands while preserving recoverable semantics.; Removed missing-line, two-gray, and full-grid bypasses; malformed, under-specified, wrong-gray, ambiguous-axis, undeclared, and unknown-control scenes now fail closed.; Pinned canonical hash 9a2961f7f72d and synchronized both base target sources, descriptions, concepts, steps, constraints, and primitive metadata.
summary: Ignore background zero and gray (5), then collect every remaining color. If every color occupies exactly one row, sort colors by the row of their first cell and emit an N by N grid whose rows are solid ordered colors. Otherwise sort by first-cell column and emit N identical rows containing the ordered color list; N is the relevant-color count.
